transform.description: A transform name from the offered list.

tools.description: Query the oracle with a transformed copy of an input you have observed. Name the base ('example', or 'query 1', 'query 2', ...) and one transform from the list the environment gives you (rotations, reflections, transposition, colour swaps, one-cell shifts). The result is the oracle's output for that transformed input, with a note on whether it is the same transform of the base's output. Counts as one query; a transform the oracle refuses does not.
